OpenAI

Language intelligence connected to your business.

Level 4Inspect the detail

Build assistants and language workflows that turn unstructured information into usable business records. MoreSpace can connect OpenAI models with your approved knowledge and narrowly scoped APIs for enquiry understanding, draft creation, and operator assistance. We design structured responses, evaluations, and human review around the task so useful automation remains accountable.

Useful outputs

  • Validated structured enquiry records
  • Reviewed content drafts with context
  • Task results and execution traces

Where we can apply it

  • Form enquiry → field extraction → validation → sales assignment.
  • Approved product facts → campaign draft → editor approval → asset production.
  • Support question → permitted knowledge retrieval → source-backed draft → human escalation.

Inputs we need

  • Approved documents and product facts
  • An agreed field schema
  • Authorized business API definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Define the task, source boundaries, and representative acceptance examples.
  • Connect retrieval or approved tools and validate the structured response.
  • Measure failures and cost, then route uncertain or consequential outcomes to an operator.

Expert review points

  • Check claims against original source material before external publication.
  • Require permission checks around business actions and escalation paths.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
